description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Characterizing the Influence of Floor Roughness on Wind Turbulence in a Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jennifer Bridge, University of Florida (ufl.edu). This project explores the influence of roughness element configurations in a boundary layer wind tunnel using data from the University of Florida Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel. It focuses on mean wind speed, turbulence intensity, skewness, and kurtosis profiles. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-tytg-nh48. Keywords: University of Florida, NHERI Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel, Wind Profiles, Wind Turbulence, REU, Higher-Order Turbulence. Published 2023-11-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
